text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the equipment inspection, which must be performed on yearly bases as indicated by Y1 in the title
block for Battary Charger:
Model: CLC -130-400 - 5, S.N.:13166-1,13166-2,13166-313166-4, AC
input:38010% V, 158A, 50HZ, 
 3 PH, DC
output :130V 400A, NO.OF
CELLS: 58
The first draft initiated by Eng 
Metwaly Mahmoud El_Sayed El_Hendawy and revised by 
Operation and maintenance's General Director: eng Mohamed Reda Abd El-Azez
Safety Precautions
Work order must be issued.
Switch off input & output supply
Tools and Equipment
Suitable Tool Set
Digital Voltmeter
Vacuum Cleaner or Blower
Brush
Work to be Carried Out
Switch off input and output supply.
Clean from air dust and dirty.
Check ventilation system and replace fans bearings.
Inspect over heating compartment of control board.
Check fuses, Contacts and Terminal Tithing.
Inspect visually for Scr's and Diodes.
Check charger ventilation area.
Check and clean transfer switch.
Switch on input and output supply.
Check input and output voltage.
